cards.example_en: The swimming pool closes at eight p.m. today.
cards.example_zh: 游泳池今天晚上八点关门。
cards.explain_zh: 放在时间后；12 p.m.是中午，12 a.m.是午夜。

cards.example_en: We missed the beginning of the film yesterday.
cards.example_zh: 我们昨天错过了电影的开头。
cards.explain_zh: at the beginning of后接名词；in the beginning表示起初。

cards.example_en: Our flat is on the third floor, beside the lift.
cards.example_zh: 我们的公寓在三楼，电梯旁边。
cards.explain_zh: 表示分数：one third；two thirds。

cards.example_en: Our flat is on the third floor, beside the lift.
cards.example_zh: 我们的公寓在三楼，电梯旁边。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We used coloured blocks to practise maths after lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午饭后，我们用彩色积木练习数学。
cards.explain_zh: 英式用 maths，美式用 math；作主语用单数动词。

cards.example_en: Strong maths skills help students interpret financial information and make informed decisions in everyday life.
cards.example_zh: 扎实的数学技能有助于学生理解财务信息，并在日常生活中作出明智决定。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We hung a colourful painting above the sofa.
cards.example_zh: 我们在沙发上方挂了一幅色彩鲜艳的画。
cards.explain_zh: 指一幅画时可数；指绘画活动时不可数。

cards.example_en: Put the milk back in the fridge, please.
cards.example_zh: 请把牛奶放回冰箱。
cards.explain_zh: fridge是refrigerator的常用简短说法。

cards.example_en: Put the milk back in the fridge, please.
cards.example_zh: 请把牛奶放回冰箱。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My cousin returned from China with beautiful mountain photographs.
cards.example_zh: 我的表亲从中国回来，带回了漂亮的山景照片。
cards.explain_zh: China指中国；小写china指瓷器，形容词用Chinese。

cards.example_en: I left my umbrella beside the front door.
cards.example_zh: 我把我的伞放在前门旁边了。
cards.explain_zh: my后须接名词；mine可独立使用，表示“我的”。

cards.example_en: I'll wash the dishes later, after we finish eating.
cards.example_zh: 等我们吃完饭，我稍后再洗碗。
cards.explain_zh: later表示稍后；latter表示两者中的后者。

cards.example_en: Children who develop strong reading habits often achieve better academic results later in life.
cards.example_zh: 养成良好阅读习惯的孩子，往往在日后的学习中取得更好的成绩。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We shared an umbrella on the walk home.
cards.example_zh: 走路回家时，我们共撑一把伞。
cards.explain_zh: umbrella term指涵盖多个相关概念的统称。

cards.example_en: An umbrella organisation can help small charities coordinate their activities and share resources more effectively.
cards.example_zh: 一个联合组织可以帮助小型慈善机构协调活动，更有效地共享资源。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.meaning_zh: 祖父母或外祖父母之一
cards.example_en: Each grandparent brought a homemade dish to our picnic.
cards.example_zh: 每位祖辈都带了一道自制的菜来参加我们的野餐。
cards.explain_zh: 单数指一位祖辈；复数可指祖父母或外祖父母。

cards.example_en: The children built a sandcastle together on the beach.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们一起在海滩上堆了一座沙堡。
cards.explain_zh: child 的不规则复数；所有格为 children's。

cards.example_en: These trousers are too long, so I need them shortened.
cards.example_zh: 这条裤子太长了，我需要把它改短。
cards.explain_zh: 用复数：trousers are；一条用a pair of trousers。

cards.example_en: Some employers require staff to wear formal trousers, while others allow more casual clothing in the workplace.
cards.example_zh: 一些雇主要求员工穿正式长裤，另一些则允许员工在工作场所穿得更休闲。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We cooked pasta with fresh tomatoes and mushrooms.
cards.example_zh: 我们用新鲜番茄和蘑菇做了意大利面。
cards.explain_zh: 不可数；一份意面可说a bowl of pasta。

cards.example_en: School canteens can serve wholegrain pasta with vegetables to provide affordable meals with more fibre.
cards.example_zh: 学校食堂可以供应搭配蔬菜的全麦意大利面，提供价格实惠、膳食纤维更多的餐食。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We play basketball at the park after school.
cards.example_zh: 放学后，我们在公园打篮球。
cards.explain_zh: play basketball不加冠词；指一个球用a basketball。

cards.example_en: We play basketball at the park after school.
cards.example_zh: 放学后，我们在公园打篮球。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The tiger rested in the shade beside a pool.
cards.example_zh: 那只老虎在水池旁的阴凉处休息。
cards.explain_zh: 可数名词；一只老虎用a tiger。

cards.example_en: Our family usually shares a special meal at Christmas.
cards.example_zh: 我们一家通常在圣诞节一起享用一顿特别的饭菜。
cards.explain_zh: 首字母大写；节日期间用at，当天用on Christmas Day。

cards.example_en: Our family usually shares a special meal at Christmas.
cards.example_zh: 我们一家通常在圣诞节一起享用一顿特别的饭菜。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The internet stopped working halfway through our video call.
cards.example_zh: 我们视频通话进行到一半时断网了。
cards.explain_zh: 通常说 the internet；作定语时不用 the。

cards.example_en: Reliable internet access enables rural students to use educational resources that may be unavailable locally.
cards.example_zh: 可靠的互联网接入让农村学生能够使用当地可能缺乏的教育资源。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Please leave your shoes by the door before entering.
cards.example_zh: 进来前请把你的鞋放在门边。
cards.explain_zh: your后接名词；yours独立使用；you're意为你是。

cards.example_en: We found a tiny bookshop beside the railway station.
cards.example_zh: 我们在火车站旁发现了一家小书店。
cards.explain_zh: bookshop常用于英式英语，美式多用bookstore。

cards.example_en: An independent bookshop can strengthen local cultural life by hosting reading groups and supporting emerging writers.
cards.example_zh: 独立书店可以通过举办读书会和支持新作家来丰富当地文化生活。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I pulled on a warm sweater before going outside.
cards.example_zh: 出门前，我套上了一件暖和的毛衣。
cards.explain_zh: 英式英语也常用jumper；sweatshirt指运动衫。

cards.example_en: Choosing a durable wool sweater rather than several cheap alternatives can reduce clothing waste over time.
cards.example_zh: 选择一件耐穿的羊毛衫，而不是多件廉价替代品，长远来看可以减少衣物浪费。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I felt too tired to cook after the walk.
cards.example_zh: 散步后我累得不想做饭。
cards.explain_zh: tired形容人感到累；tiring形容事情令人累。

cards.example_en: We travelled around Spain by train last summer.
cards.example_zh: 去年夏天，我们乘火车游览了西班牙。
cards.explain_zh: 国名首字母大写，前面通常不加the。

cards.example_en: She keeps a small notebook beside her bed.
cards.example_zh: 她在床边放着一本小笔记本。
cards.explain_zh: 通常指纸质笔记本；电脑义也可说notebook computer。

cards.example_en: My sister is married and lives near the coast.
cards.example_zh: 我姐姐已婚，住在海岸附近。
cards.explain_zh: 与某人结婚用 be/get married to，不用 with。

cards.example_en: My cousin travelled across Europe by train last summer.
cards.example_zh: 我表亲去年夏天乘火车游历了欧洲。
cards.explain_zh: Europe首字母大写，通常不加the；不等于欧盟。

cards.example_en: My cousin travelled across Europe by train last summer.
cards.example_zh: 我表亲去年夏天乘火车游历了欧洲。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Growing herbs on my balcony has become my favourite hobby.
cards.example_zh: 在阳台种香草已成了我最喜欢的业余爱好。
cards.explain_zh: 可数名词，复数为hobbies；开始一种爱好用take up。

cards.example_en: Having a creative hobby can help people manage stress and maintain a healthy balance between work and leisure.
cards.example_zh: 拥有创造性的业余爱好能帮助人们调节压力，保持工作与休闲之间的健康平衡。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I packed a cheese sandwich and an apple for lunch.
cards.example_zh: 我带了一个奶酪三明治和一个苹果当午餐。
cards.explain_zh: 动词常用被动结构be sandwiched between。

cards.example_en: I packed a cheese sandwich and an apple for lunch.
cards.example_zh: 我带了一个奶酪三明治和一个苹果当午餐。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: It was cloudy, so we left our sunglasses at home.
cards.example_zh: 当时天阴着，所以我们把太阳镜留在了家里。
cards.explain_zh: 既可形容天空多云，也可形容液体浑浊。

cards.example_en: The application form asks for my nationality and address.
cards.example_zh: 申请表要求填写我的国籍和地址。
cards.explain_zh: nationality指国籍，不等同于出生地或族裔。

cards.example_en: My feet felt cold against the kitchen tiles.
cards.example_zh: 我的脚踩在厨房瓷砖上，感觉冰凉。
cards.explain_zh: foot的复数是feet；作前置修饰语用单数，如six-foot。

cards.example_en: We curled up on the sofa after dinner.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭后，我们蜷坐在沙发上。
cards.explain_zh: 坐在沙发上用on the sofa，不用in。

cards.example_en: We found an interesting little museum near the station.
cards.example_zh: 我们在车站附近发现了一家有趣的小博物馆。
cards.explain_zh: interesting形容事物引人兴趣，不等于funny好笑。

cards.example_en: Walking to the shops takes about ten minutes.
cards.example_zh: 步行去商店大约需要十分钟。
cards.explain_zh: walking中的l不发音；步行去某地也可用on foot。

cards.example_en: We arrived at the airport before the sun rose.
cards.example_zh: 太阳还没升起，我们就到了机场。
cards.explain_zh: 在机场通常用at the airport；航站楼是terminal。

word.example_en: Approximately one third of the city's residents rely on public transport for their daily commute.
word.example_zh: 该市约三分之一的居民依靠公共交通进行日常通勤。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0
